_comment: Expected Urban Local Bodies (ULB) count in Uttar Pradesh: ~17 Nagar Nigam, ~200 Nagar Palika Parishad, ~546 Nagar Panchayat (Total: ~763). District-level expected breakdown is not officially standardized in a machine-readable format across all 75 districts. Leave per-district mapping empty until an authenticated Directorate of Urban Local Bodies (DULB) dataset is provided.
